findings.title: Conditional refund-interest provision applied to an ordinary deposit claim
findings.reply_excerpt: If a landlord fails to refund the deposit, they are liable to pay simple interest on the amount they failed to refund.
findings.source_excerpt: Where a landlord exercises the right of recovery of possession under sub-section (2) of section 21 or under section 22
findings.finding: The reply presents interest as a general consequence of withholding this security deposit. The cited source ties the refund duty to specified recovery-of-possession scenarios; those triggering facts were not supplied. This is a potential unsupported applicability claim despite verifier.status=fixed/pass, requiring human legal review.
findings.expected: State only the support established by the cited source and known facts; qualify or omit the interest claim when the source's applicability conditions have not been established.

findings.title: Draft silently selects one of two explicitly disputed vacation dates
findings.layer: case-file fact merging / draft generation / verifier
findings.input_excerpt: I'm not sure which is the vacation date. Draft it without silently choosing either date.
findings.finding: The final draft uses 10 October 2026 in its tenancy-period and vacation-date statements even after the user explicitly disputed 10 versus 20 October. Generic instructions to confirm legal provisions do not acknowledge this factual conflict; the final verifier still reports pass.
findings.expected: Acknowledge the conflicting dates and leave the vacation/hand-over date as a visible placeholder until the user confirms it.
